summary: This directory contains the core logic for FTP protocol interactions, providing the necessary abstractions to perform file system operations, manage data streams, and retrieve metadata from remote FTP servers.
responsibilities: Uploading data streams to remote destinations
Downloading remote content as data streams
relationships: The FTP client utilizes transport operations to execute file transfers.
Data streams serve as the primary medium for transferring file content.
Metadata retrieval provides contextual information regarding remote file system structures.
designDecisions: Utilizes streaming for memory-efficient data handling
Separates data movement operations from metadata retrieval
